column1: # Environment and Climate Change Canada present weather codes, as SWOB
# reports them in prsnt_wx_1 and prsnt_wx_2. Read: every code and its
# English description come from the SWOB-ML Product User Guide, version
# Derived: the phrase column is the code put in Environment Canada's own
# current-condition words, which then go through map_condition_canada like
# any observed condition. An empty phrase is not weather at the station now:
# a code about the preceding hour (the manned 20 to 29 and automated 321 to
# 326 groups, numbered as WMO tables 4677 and 4680 head them, and every
# "Recent" code), cloud development, weather in the vicinity or at a
# distance, deposits on the ground, and reserved or missing values.
